name: San-el Muhendislik Elektrik Taahhut Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: San-el Mühendislik Elektrik Taahhüt Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells electrical panels in Turkey. The company offers LV and MV power capacitors, LV and MV harmonic filter reactors, LV thyristor switching modules, and GE switchgears. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
